capabilities: Scan MD, TXT, CSV, DOCX and XLSX sources for suspected sensitive values
Review and accept or keep each detected replacement item by item
Create safe copies outside the vault after reopen and residue checks
Encrypt token mappings in an external job store with a passphrase-derived AES-256-GCM key
Restore AI-returned result JSON into a new results folder after validating hashes and tokens
disambiguation: Not a vault backup or encryption tool; it pseudonymizes selected documents into new safe copies and never overwrites the originals.
extras: Desktop-only; manual installation from GitHub Release is required until the official directory listing is approved; processing is fully local with no telemetry; detection is explicitly not a legal anonymization guarantee and manual review is always required.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pseudonymize sensitive documents locally before sharing them or handing them to AI tools.
summary: Read-only pseudonymization tool that scans MD, TXT, CSV, DOCX and XLSX files for sensitive data and writes reviewed safe copies outside the vault.
